'''Ostan Atur''' was a a skilled [[Lowen]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] who proved to be a hindrance to several key [[New Republic/Legends|Republic]] installations like the [[Qua'Tahc]] [[Meleenium/Legends|meleenium]] mines on [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]] under the jurisdiction of the New Republic.

==Biography==
Ostan Atur was born on [[Low'n]], a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where she was surrounded by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Tempted by the amount of money she could earn, Atur decided to become a [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]] and eventually began working for the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] gangster [[Tolad Dor]]. She worked for Dor for close to two years, during which time she killed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Sil Ompren]] by rigging [[Detonator/Legends|detonators]] to a repulsorcraft. Atur also crippled many [[Starship/Legends|starships]], to allow Dor's minions to collect their cargo to sell on the invisible market.<ref name="WBC" />

She eventually elocated to the little-known [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] and entered a partnership with the [[Reigat]] [[Talak]]. Atur was chosen by [[Rani Quanic]] to aid in the theft of 100 kilograms of meleenium from New Republic mines. During the heist, Atur disabled several of the security systems and several [[B1-series worker droid|B1 worker droids]] on duty in one of the Qua'Tahc tunnels' southeast shafts enabling the criminals to escape relatively easily.<ref name="WBC" />

However, a group of three Republic operatives came upon the fleeing [[Thief/Legends|thieves]]. Atur and her companions sprayed the area with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, which caused the three Republic operatives to be seriously wounded. After the heist, there was a reward for her capture of 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="WBC" />

==Personality and traits==
As a result of being raised among cutthroat mercenaries, smugglers and other lawbreakers, she took to the customs and became both quite independent and dauntless, seeking bigger and better opportunities and more challenging assignments.<ref name="WBC" />

==Skills and abilities==
Having learned a great deal about technology of all sorts while frequenting Low'n spaceports and tech shops, she was capable of computer and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programming and repair, demolition, first aid, repulsorlift and transports repair, and was skilled in disabling all these types of equipment.<ref name="WBC" />

===Equipment===
She was usually seen with a blaster pistol, a comlink, a datapad, a pocket computer, and a security tool kit.<ref name="WBC" />
